rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Atlassian NetScaler bridges Jira and Confluence Server/Data Center deployments behind Citrix NetScaler single sign-on, automatically capturing the NetScaler session cookie via Playwright and storing it securely in the OS keychain. It supports per-customer configuration profiles for custom Jira fields and exposes all tools through a FastMCP HTTP/SSE transport. Compatible with macOS Keychain, libsecret on Linux, and Windows Credential Manager.
